reviewer: skills_audit agent; independent of source discovery and proposed-IR authorship
reviewedScope: All sixty complete Oracle bodies, normal single-face types, plain fixed costs, fixed integer stats and existing keyword/mana clauses.
Twenty-three mandatory draw-one and thirty-seven mandatory life-gain programs preserve the printed effect and use the trigger controller, not source ownership or later control.
All forty research rule spans and every scenario rule span match the pinned rulebook bytes; all thirty-four scenario drafts remain unexecuted.
Current imported rulings table contains zero rows for these sixty identities; no ruling coverage beyond that query is claimed.

corrections.finding: Exact accepted-command retries must return the original receipt; stale unrelated commands reject. The first draft's phrase stale receipts could contradict durable idempotency.
Ability resolution must preserve departed-active-player continuation under CR800.4j; never grant priority to the departed seat.

exclusionsConfirmed: No optional, combined-effect, other-object, intervening-if, variable-value, reminder-bearing or hybrid-cost body is accepted by this sixty-record proposal.
Baleful Strix keeps flying/deathtouch; Wall of Omens and Wall of Blossoms keep defender; Llanowar Visionary keeps its separately constrained green tap-mana ability.
Artifact/enchantment creature types remain exact source characteristics; none of these sixty is a proposed commander.
runtimeRequirementsNotProven: Committed event capture, post-event effective ability lookup, independent source-generation instances and captured controller.
State-based fixed points, APNAP cohorts and controller permutation choices before appropriate priority, plus distinct noncard stack objects.
Source-independent ability resolution, player-departure removal, preserved waiting/ordering/stack contexts, exact replay/import/retry and resolver equivalence.
limitation: This review approves the bounded source-to-proposed-IR mapping and scenario expectations. It introduces no executable trigger release, certifies no card as supported, and does not turn source inspection into runtime or full-game evidence.
